7575343627837213984.author: alexcookjoy
7575343627837213984.caption: This one earns its spot weekly 🥢Teriyaki Chicken Stir Fry ■ INGREDIENTS For the chicken: • 2 large chicken breasts (about 1.2 lbs / 550 g), thinly sliced • 1 tbsp cornstarch (8 g) • salt & black pepper • 1 tbsp vegetable oil (15 ml) For the vegetables: • 1 red bell pepper, sliced (120 g) • 1 cup broccoli florets (100 g) • 1 small carrot, thin strips (70 g) • ½ small white onion, sliced (60 g) • 2 green onions, chopped • ½ cup unsalted cashews (70 g) (optional) For the teriyaki sauce: • ¼ cup soy sauce (60 ml) • 3 tbsp cold water (45 ml) • 2 tbsp honey or brown sugar (30 g) • 1 tbsp rice vinegar (15 ml) • 1 tbsp sesame oil (15 ml) • 2 cloves garlic, minced • 1 tsp grated ginger • 1 tbsp cornstarch (8 g) To serve: • cooked jasmine rice or noodles • sesame seeds • extra green onion ■ HOW TO COOK: 1. Season sliced chicken with salt & pepper. Toss with 1 tbsp cornstarch. 2. Whisk soy sauce, water, honey, rice vinegar, sesame oil, garlic, ginger, and cornstarch. Set aside. 3. Add cashews to a dry pan and toast 2–3 minutes until golden (optional). Remove. 4. Heat oil in a pan over medium-high (375°F / 190°C). Add chicken and stir-fry 5–6 minutes until golden. Remove to a plate. 5. Add bell pepper, broccoli, carrot, and white onion. Cook 3–4 minutes until crisp-tender. 6. Return chicken. Pour in the teriyaki sauce. Stir 1–2 minutes until the sauce thickens and becomes glossy. 7. Add green onions + toasted cashews (if using). Toss and remove from heat. ■ INFO (approx.): Prep: 10 min  Cook: 15 min  Total: ~25 min Makes: 2 servings 650 kcal | 50 g protein | 17 g fat | 70 g carbs (per serving) #teriyaki #stirfry #chickenrecipe #chickenrecipes #dinnerideas

7623838997428866306.author: cookwithcourt_
7623838997428866306.caption: CHIPOTLE BEEF STUFFED PEPPERS + HERBY RICE 🍋‍🟩🥑🫑  540 CALS 41G PROTEIN  One of my fave high protein, low calorie meals. It’s actually super easy and so much fun to make! Perfect if you want to add something abit different to your weekly meal plan.  Ingredients: 400g 3% fat beef (or kidney beans for a veggie alternative) 1 tin chopped tomatoes  2tbsp chipotle paste  1tbsp tomato puree  1tbsp paprika  1tbsp smoked paprika 1/2 onion  3 cloves garlic  1 red chilli 2 red peppers  2 handfuls mozzarella  Long grain rice 1 lime  Handful chopped corriander  Optional garnish:  1tbsp Guacamole  1tbsp natural yog  Method:  Halve the red peppers, drizzle In olive oil and season.  Bake in the oven for 25 minutes.  Meanwhile, fry off the beef mince until brown. Then add onion, garlic and chilli. Cook for a few minutes.  Add the tomato puree and chipotle paste and cook out for a few minutes. Then add the tinned toms and 1/2 tin water.  Cook until reduced. Once the peppers are done, add the beef mince and mozzarella and bake for a further 20 minutes or until the cheese is golden brown.  Serve over herby rice with a dollop of guacamole and yoghurt! Enjoy♥️ #easyrecipes #dinnerideas #healthyrecipes #highprotein #beefrecipe

7662770977696140558.author: cheffinwithzach
7662770977696140558.caption: The easiest way to make the perfect hash brown. # Ingredients - 4 medium russet potatoes (about 1¾ pounds), peeled - 1 teaspoon kosher salt, plus more to finish - Neutral oil, generous amount # Instructions 1. Grate the potatoes on the large holes of a box grater. Transfer to a large bowl, toss with the kosher salt, and let sit for 5–10 minutes. The salt will draw out moisture. 2. Transfer the shredded potato to a clean kitchen towel and squeeze out as much moisture as possible. Really wring it out — the drier the potato, the better the crust. 3. Add a generous layer of neutral oil to a 10-inch non-stick skillet over medium heat. Once the oil is shimmering, add the shredded potato and pack it firmly into an even layer with a spatula. 4. Cook until the bottom is deep golden brown, about 8–10 minutes. Swirl around in the pan for a more even cook. 5. To flip, place a plate larger than the pan over the pan, then invert both in one swift motion so the hash brown drops onto the plate. Add a little oil to the pan, then slide the hash brown back in, uncooked side down. Cook until the second side is equally golden, another 8–10 minutes. If the first side didn’t crisp up enough, flip it back and give it a few more minutes in the pan. 6. Season with salt immediately and serve.

7600086099364416790.author: tablebymax
7600086099364416790.caption: Crunchy Gnocchi Salat. Knusprige Gnocchi aus der Heißluftfritteuse treffen auf einen frischen Romanasalat mit cremigem Dill Dressing. Warm trifft kalt, cremig trifft Crunch. Perfekt als leichtes Abendessen oder sättigender Salat. Zutaten: - Gnocchi ungekocht - Romanasalat - Salatgurke - Rote Zwiebel - Olivenöl Gewürze für die Gnocchi: - Knoblauchpulver - Paprikapulver - Chilisalz - Pfeffer - Oregano Dressing: - Joghurt - Saure Sahne - Zitronensaft - Knoblauchpulver - Chilisalz - Pfeffer - Frischer Dill Zubereitung: 1. Gnocchi mit Olivenöl und allen Gewürzen vermengen. 2. In der Heißluftfritteuse bei 200 Grad ca. 22 Minuten knusprig backen. 3. Romanasalat, Gurke und rote Zwiebel schneiden und in eine Schüssel geben. 4. Alle Zutaten für das Dressing cremig verrühren. 5. Dressing über den Salat geben und vermengen. 6. Knusprige Gnocchi auf den Salat geben, alles kurz mischen und servieren. @COSORI 🧡  #gnocchi #airfryer #salat #schnellesabendessen #einfacherezepte

7584981209348853000.author: recipeincaption
7584981209348853000.caption: Sheet-Pan Chicken Fajitas with Roasted Garlic Chipotle Sauce 🔥 All the flavor, one pan… juicy spiced chicken loaded with garlicky goodness 🧄 Chicken marinade -2 lb (0.8 kg) boneless skinless chicken thighs, sliced -3 tbsp mayonnaise -2 tbsp @primalkitchenfoods avocado oil -2 tbsp honey + Juice of 1 lime -7 garlic cloves, minced -Seasonings: 2 tsp paprika, 1 tbsp chili powder, 1 tbsp cumin, 1 tsp cayenne (optional), 2 tsp oregano, 2 tsp onion powder, 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp salt & 2 tsp  pepper Veggies: -1/2 red onion, sliced -1/2 each of a red, yellow, orange and green bell pepper, sliced -2 tbsp avocado oil -Veggie seasonings (1 tsp each): garlic powder, cumin, chili powder, paprika, oregano, onion powder, salt, pepper For the Roasted garlic: -1 head of garlic, top 1/4 sliced off + 1 tbsp oil of choice + 1 tsp salt Roasted garlic chipotle sauce: -1/2 cup sour cream + 1/4 cup mayonnaise -Roasted garlic (the whole head) -2 chipotle pepper + 1 tbsp honey + Juice of 1/2 lime 1. Add the sliced chicken to a bowl with mayo, avocado oil, honey, lime juice, garlic, and all chicken seasonings. Toss until everything is coated. Marinate for at least a few mins, or up to overnight. Longer = better flavor. 2. Preheat oven to 425°F (220°C). Drizzle the garlic head with oil and salt, wrap it in foil like a little flavor gift, and place on a tray. Roast for 45–60 minutes, until soft & golden. 3. Add all sliced veggies to a large sheet pan. Drizzle with avocado oil, sprinkle with veggie seasonings, and toss to coat. Add the marinated chicken directly onto the pan with the veggies. Toss everything together so it plays nice. Bake for 20–25 minutes, until the chicken is fully cooked, lightly charred, and the veggies are tender. 4. Once the garlic is cool, squeeze the roasted cloves into a blender or food processor. Add sour cream, mayo, chipotle peppers, honey, and lime juice. Blend until smooth. 5. Spoon pan juices back over the chicken. Top with cilantro, extra lime, and dollops of the chipotle sauce. I love turning this into wraps. Load up tortillas and crisp them in a buttered pan. #dinner #recipesoftiktok #recipe

7578421707099098390.author: bartlomiej_wlodarczyk
7578421707099098390.caption: Sajgonki 🤤 Zapisz na później i zaobserwuj po więcej takich przepisów! ✅ Składniki na 12 sajognek: 👉🏻500g mięsa mielonego wieprzowego 👉🏻12x płatów papieru ryżowego 👉🏻1x duża marchew 👉🏻1x cebula 👉🏻5x ząbek czosnku 👉🏻25g pietruszki 👉🏻20g szczypiorku 👉🏻20 ml sosu sojowego 👉🏻10g oliwy z oliwek 👉🏻6g imbiru świeżego 👉🏻7g papryki słodkiej 👉🏻3x szczypta soli 👉🏻3x szczypta pieprzu Dodatkowo ale opcjonalnie:  👉🏻sos słodko kwaśny 1️⃣Cebulę i imbir pokrój na drobną kostkę, czosnek pokrój w plastry, a marchew zetrzyj na tarce. Posiekaj szczypiorek i pietruszkę. 2️⃣Podsmaż cebulę na rozgrzanej patelni z 1/2 oliwy przez 5-6 minut.  3️⃣Po tym czasie dodaj marchew i smaż 2-3 minuty. 4️⃣Następnie dodaj mięso mielone i smaż, aż do zarumienienia.  5️⃣Dodaj na patelnie szczypiorek, pietruszkę, imbir, czosnek, sos sojowy i przyprawy.  6️⃣Całość smaż jeszcze przez 2-3 minuty, co jakiś czas mieszając. 7️⃣Namoczony płat ryżu papierowego połóż na desce/talerzu.  8️⃣Nałóż farsz i zawiń jak krokieta. Czynność powtarzaj, aż do wykorzystania farszu. 9️⃣Podsmaż sajgonki na patelni z oliwą z każdej strony. Możesz spakować je w pojemnik i wziąć na wynos! ✅Jedna sajgonka posiada 103 kcal, w tym 10g białka, 3g tłuszczów i 11g węglowodanów.  ⏱Przygotowanie tego przepisu zajmuje 30 minut.  #bartlomiej_wlodarczyk #sajgonki #springrolls #obiad #przepisy

7554727923769429255.caption: 🇲🇦 Moroccan Harira | Soups So Good It Can Cure Any Sickness Ep. 15 INGREDIENTS: - 500g of lamb shoulder, cut into small cubes - Oil for frying - 1 large onion, chopped - 6-10 garlic cloves, chopped - 3 tbsp of tomato paste - 2 tsp of ginger - 1 tbsp of ground turmeric - 1 tsp of cinnamon  - 1 tsp of ground cumin - ¾ cup of chickpeas - ¾ cup brown lentils - Beef broth as needed - crushed tomatoes - 1 celery stalk (with leaves), finely chopped and cubed - 1 bunch of cilantro, chopped - 1 bunch of parsley, chopped - Flour slurry - Salt & pepper to taste - 1/2 cup broken vermicelli *all measurements are estimates. cook and season with your ❤️ INSTRUCTIONS - Heat the oil in a pot. Add in lamb and sear until browned. remove and set aside. - Stir in the onion, garlic, and add back your lamb. Add tomato paste and stir until well combined before adding celery and leaves along with the spices. - Add lentils, chickpeas, crushed tomatoes, and beef broth until the pot is full. let cook for about 40 mins or until lentils are soft. - Add your cilantro and parsley and vermicelli noodles. 7556360325239541010.author: recipeincaption
7556360325239541010.caption: Cajun Chicken Pasta 🔥 Full extended written recipe with macros is in my bio 🫡 One pan, zero stress, all the flavor… creamy, garlicky, spicy Cajun goodness in every bite. -2 large chicken breasts, flattened -3 tbsp cajun seasoning (homemade blend below or store-bought) -1 medium yellow onion, diced -1 bell pepper, thinly sliced (I used ¼ each of red, orange, yellow & green for vibes ✨) -8 garlic cloves, minced -1 cup heavy cream, room temp (can sub: 1 cup cold milk + 1 tbsp cornstarch, whisked smooth) -5 tbsp butter -2 tbsp neutral oil (@algaecookingclub is my go-to) -1 cup fresh spinach -Extra seasoning boost: 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp pepper, 1 tsp cayenne, 1 tsp Italian seasoning -¾ cup parmesan cheese, grated (freshly grated > pre-bagged, always) -½ cup pasta water (aka liquid gold) -8 oz (225 g) rigatoni -Fresh basil, for garnish (optional) Homemade Cajun Seasoning: 1 tbsp paprika, 1 ½ tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp onion powder, ½ tsp black pepper. ½ tsp Italian seasoning, ½ tsp salt, ½ tsp cayenne 1. Pat the chicken dry. Flatten slightly so it cooks evenly. Rub chicken with 1 tbsp olive oil and coat fully in Cajun until bronzed all over.  2. Bring a big pot of salted water to a boil. Cook pasta until al dente (box time minus 1 minute). Reserve a cup of pasta water (liquid gold), then drain & drizzle with olive oil to avoid clumping. 3. In a large pan over medium-high heat, add 2 tbsp neutral oil + 1 tbsp butter. Sear chicken 4 mins per side until golden. Lower heat, add 2 tbsp butter, and baste until cooked through. Remove and set aside.  4. In the same pan, melt 2 tbsp of butter, add diced onion and sauté until softened and golden (about 5 mins). Toss in bell peppers + extra seasonings, sauté 6-7 mins until soft. Add minced garlic, cook 2 mins. 5. Lower to medium-low. Stir in cream and let it gently simmer. Add spinach and parmesan, mix for a minute. Add pasta + 1/4 cup pasta water, toss well over low heat for 1–2 mins to emulsify. If sauce is too thick, splash in more pasta water. Slice chicken, lay on top, and serve with fresh basil and obviously, more parm! #dinner #easyrecipe #easymeal #cooking #recipesoftiktok #easydinner #homecooking

7530843903323360543.caption: Sheet Pan Cheesy Chicken Fajita Burritos THE SHEET PAN MEAL PREP SERIES EPISODE 1 Per Burrito (Makes 12) 445 Calories 42g Protein 35g Carbs 16g Fat —— Fajita Veggies 6 bell peppers, diced 2 onions, diced 15g (1 Tbsp) coarse salt Fajita Chicken: 1360g (48oz) boneless, skinless chicken thighs, diced 40g (2 Tbsp) tomato paste 30g (2 Tbsp) chili paste (harissa or adobo sauce) 3 packets taco seasoning 20g (1 ½ Tbsp) neutral oil Optional: oregano and chili powder, to taste Burrito Fillings: 280g (10oz) pico de gallo 150g (⅔ cup) 0% Greek yogurt 120g (1 cup) reduced-fat mozzarella cheese 80g (⅔ cup) reduced-fat cheddar cheese  Optional Topping 80g (⅔ cup) reduced-fat mozzarella (for melting on top) Chopped fresh cilantro, for garnish Assembly 12 @eatcounter burrito-sized protein tortillas* (or burrito sized tortillas of choice) Instructions 1.) Preheat oven to 425°F. On a large sheet pan, toss diced bell peppers and onions with coarse salt. Roast for 20-30 minutes, or until soft and moisture has mostly evaporated. 2.) Remove pan from oven. Add diced chicken thighs directly on top of the roasted veggies. Add tomato paste, chili paste, taco seasoning, oil, and optional spices. Mix everything together directly on the pan until well combined. 3.) Return pan to oven and roast for another 18-20 minutes, or until chicken is fully cooked. For extra browning, switch oven to broil for 2-3 minutes at the end. 4.) Remove from oven and immediately add pico de gallo, shredded mozzarella, cheddar, and Greek yogurt. Stir everything together on the pan until the cheese is melted and mixture is fully combined. 5.) Sprinkle additional mozzarella over the top and return to oven for 2-3 minutes to melt. Garnish with chopped cilantro. 6.) Use a spatula to divide the mixture on the pan into 12 evenly sized sections - these will be your burrito portions. 7.) Place one portion of filling in each burrito-sized tortilla and roll tightly. Wrap in foil or parchment and freeze for later. To reheat, wrap in a paper towel and microwave for 3-4 mins, air fry or pan fry after if you want a crispy tortilla. Enjoy! #stealthhealth #mealprep #sheetpan #sheetpanmealprep #sheetpanrecipes
